decides: 摄影机站在哪、朝哪指——同一个场景换机位就是另一张图、另一种情绪

items.prompt: heroic low-angle shot looking up at the subject, camera at knee height with strong perspective convergence, subject feeling larger than the frame, sky or ceiling dominating the upper half
high bird's-eye overhead view, entire scene flattened into a readable diagram, figures small within a large environment, long shadows revealing spatial layout
items.note: 俯瞰适合交代关系与位置

items.prompt: tight facial close-up, eyes placed on the upper third following portrait convention, shallow depth softening the ears and shoulders, every highlight shape in the iris deliberate
items.note: 特写的纪律：眼神光要有一个主源

items.prompt: wide establishing shot, subject placed small within a large legible environment, deep layered recession from foreground to horizon, scale communicated by recognizable reference objects
items.note: 环境是主角，人是比例尺

items.prompt: over-the-shoulder two-shot, one shoulder and head in the near foreground framing the other figure, focus on the facing character, conversation staging with clear eyeline geometry
items.note: 过肩是对话戏的默认机位

items.prompt: dutch tilt composition with the horizon deliberately off-level, diagonal stress in vertical architecture, unease built from geometry rather than content
items.note: 斜角是情绪警告，别滥用

items.prompt: first-person point of view, the viewer's own hands or equipment visible at the frame edge, subject facing the camera directly, wide lens slight distortion at the corners
items.note: POV 的代入感来自「自己的身体」

items.prompt: chased-from-behind shot following the subject's back, destination occupying the frame ahead, shoulders and hair carrying the emotion, viewer positioned as companion rather than observer
items.note: 背影把情绪让给观众去填

items.prompt: diagonal motion composition, subject crossing the frame on a strong diagonal with motion lines trailing, camera slightly rotated to match the momentum, empty space ahead receiving the movement
items.note: 运动方向的前方必须留空

items.prompt: strictly symmetrical composition, subject centered on the vertical axis with mirrored architecture or crowd on both sides, formal ritual-like stillness
items.note: 对称给仪式感，也給压抑

items.prompt: macro detail shot of a single small element, extremely shallow focus with the rest of the frame dissolved into bokeh, surface texture and material truth as the subject
items.note: 细节镜头的材质必须扛住放大

items.prompt: tracking shot composition with motion blur on the background only, subject sharp against horizontal streaks, camera velocity implied by background smearing
items.note: 只糊背景不糊主体，速度感才对
